First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Foothills Bicycle Club Sunday & Tuesday Social Rides group ride

A loose group of active senior cyclists who winter in the Yuma area. The Sunday and Tuesday rides are about 25 miles at a relaxed pace from the Foothills Library. Thursday and Saturday rides are longer and faster (35 to 45 miles, 13 to 17 mph) and start at Los Amigos / Southern Sands. Email the club for the monthly ride calendar and start times.
